correctness.rationale: The pathwise reverse balanced-bridge representation S_m=m+(1/2)sum_{t=1}^{2m}|D_t|/t fixes normalization. Conditional Bernoulli orthogonality gives exact E[M_m^2]. Hypergeometric sub-Gaussian fourth moments control t≈0 and upgrade the Brownian bridge functional convergence to second moments. The two-time bivariate-Gaussian absolute-moment integration, with J(u)=int_0^∞[(1+y)(1+uy)]^-2dy, yields E A^2=2log2-1/2. Kuba--Panholzer's total-score variance and T=S+M imply covariance coefficient 1/2-log2. Independently checked exact finite-deck variance identities m=1..6; these are diagnostics rather than infinite proof.
